title: Happy llama
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='22' rx='5' ry='12' fill='#f5c98a' transform='rotate(-15 32 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='22' rx='5' ry='12' fill='#f5c98a' transform='rotate(15 68 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='22' rx='2.5' ry='7' fill='#ffb6c1' transform='rotate(-15 32 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='22' rx='2.5' ry='7' fill='#ffb6c1' transform='rotate(15 68 22)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#ffd9a0'/>
  <!-- fluffy top -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='20' r='6' fill='#ffe8c2'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='20' r='6' fill='#ffe8c2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='6' fill='#fff2dc'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#fff0d0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='35' r='3.5' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='35' r='3.5' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='34' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 50 Q50 56 56 50' stroke='#8b6a4a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='47' r='1.2' fill='#8b6a4a'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='47' r='1.2' fill='#8b6a4a'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='43' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ffb0b0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='43' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ffb0b0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='42' y='55' width='16' height='18' rx='6' fill='#ffd9a0'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#ffe8c2'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='33' y='86' width='7' height='10' rx='3' fill='#f5c98a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='86' width='7' height='10' rx='3' fill='#f5c98a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='72' r='5' fill='#fff2dc'/>
  <!-- fluff on chest -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='6' fill='#fff2dc'/>
</svg>
